notes: Focused single-competency task: produce a probability array over a fixed vocabulary meeting both forward- and reverse-KL budgets, via the documented mixing-with-uniform halving method. The verifier re-runs the deliverable on seven hidden priors/budget pairs (zero budgets returning the exact normalized prior, length-1, huge budgets, a very tight pair needing many halvings, numpy/list input polymorphism) and validates the visible /app/calibrated.json against the agent's own function. Shape/value failures (wrong length, non-finite, non-positive, unnormalized) are all probed.
